notes.title: Hello Spööktubers! Thank you for your patience as we're fixing bugs on all platforms.

items.text: Here's a new patch fixing some stuff!
For those of you wondering when crossplay between Switch 1 & 2 and other platforms will be back:

The first Switch patch ran into an issue during testing, so we’re currently waiting on feedback from Nintendo. We’re hoping the patch will be approved by next week, but it could take longer if any problems are found. The fixes from this patch will also be included.
Lobbies should no longer be stuck in offline mode after rehosting
The door in the house should no longer be open only for the host due to the aforementioned issue
Video extraction time has been greatly reduced in most use cases

notes.title: Enjoy the patch, and please report any issues to support@landfall.se

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957545/4de384fe395190bf5323812c7ce4db23cf3dd830.gif"]

Hello everyone! Thank you for your patience as we've been sorting out the issues appearing after the console launch. In this patch, we hope to have sorted most of them, but we're still looking into some of the more complex issues. If you're still having trouble, please email support@landfall.se so we can try to help you troubleshoot.
Xbox and Playstation also got big patches so if you have a friend over there please tell them we've sorted a lot of the issues now.
Heads up: Crossplay will be disabled on Nintendo Switch 1 & 2 for a few days as the patch there is taking longer to get passed.
Improved mute consistency and being unable to unmute certain players
Added options for inverted vertical and horizontal controls under the controller tab
Better clarification for the room codes
The lobby no longer reopens whenever you fail to meet your quota.
If the video fails to be extracted for some, but not all users, it will still be watchable for the users who successfully extracted it.
Improved clarity on the selfie mode tooltip
Fixed being unable to write full room code on the Steam Deck
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957545/1046dc05685564812cfde19bbb11b3f9e74f0570.gif"]
Hello everyone! Sorry about the issues caused by yesterday's patch, we're looking into them all but here's a patch fixing the issue where you couldn't hear other players.
When joining an existing lobby, you can now properly hear everyone else

notes.title: Happy 2nd Birthday to Content Warning Spööktubers!

items.text: Today, we launched Content Warning on PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series S|X and Nintendo Switch 1 & 2.
With this launch, we also added crossplay to the Steam version, meaning you can now play with your friends on other platforms using friend codes.
Enabled crossplay and added crossplay to the settings menu
Fixed a bug that made users with Unicode characters in their PC name unable to record videos
The game is now Steam Deck verified
Improved localisation and missing characters in different fonts
Fixed multiple aspect ratio bugs
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957545/4de384fe395190bf5323812c7ce4db23cf3dd830.gif"]
Fixed sounds being way louder than intended
Fixed the pitch of sounds being off
All spinning machinery should now hurt the player in Factory
Jello now covers the screen of players who get caught
Spööktube Cloutlourd Achievement now works
Not a Bot! Can Achievement now works
Closing a lobby can no longer grant the Any% Achievement
Using a defibrillator no longer gives everyone the “Certified Medic” achievement
Rebinding keys should now work properly, regardless of keyboard layout
UI improvements
Fixed bots teleporting in front of players

We're still looking into some of the other bugs, specifically around video extraction issues - please keep sending reports and logs to support@landfall.se and we hope to get them fixed in the new year.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957545/1046dc05685564812cfde19bbb11b3f9e74f0570.gif"]
Fixed some missing colliders on the railings in the factory
The UI should adjust correctly now when changing resolution
The camera should no longer get stuck in place after being picked up when it was still recording
More SFX sounds should now be properly adjusted
Lasers SFX now on the correct location
Text on the player customizer should now be visible in all languages
Snatcho no longer invincible
EyeGuy should now properly attack you when lit up
Monsters shouldn’t teleport as often
Fixed extraction text overlap when extracting multiple clips
Added a placeholder counter for users to see how many videos are left before extraction begins
Rescue hook now properly rescues
Steam invites (hopefully) works completely as expected
Confirm quit before leaving or closing the game.
You can now do more than one sponsorship per save file
Players can now disable shadows.
Reduced extraction loading time
Legacy version for Content Warning added to guarantee the old mods still work & for those who do not have AVX support on their CPUs (find among properties - betas)

releases.displayName: Small update with Achievements, lobby codes, optimisation and bug fixes!

items.text: We're very grateful to you all for playing Content Warning, even if there haven't been many updates since launch! 🙏 It's been great seeing the mods come in from the mod support update last year! Thank you to all the modders for making such cool stuff for the community ❤️
We just updated the game with a bunch of achievements, lobby codes and fixes/improvements/optimisations! Read more below:
Added lobby codes
Better (Full?) controller support
Catchya Machine no longer spawns in single player/offline mode.
Catchya Machine can now be solved with controllers.
Sketchpad can now also be used with a controller.
Muting players.
Added achievements
Updated to a secure Unity version.
Monsters shouldn’t fall out of the map anymore.
Monsters shouldn’t get stuck walking up ramps as often.

Items that fall off the map in the surface level now respawn. (We noticed people complaining that the drone sometimes doesn’t drop items or they fall through the ground, they should now respawn on the drop-site eventually).
Extraction of videos now properly does not start until all players have loaded all the videos.
Higher overall FPS
Optimised Surface considerably
Optimised the top of the Factory level
Build size about 400MB smaller
Lower VRAM usage
Faster loading times
Even though we did an update today, we want to manage expectations going forward regarding the future:

Content Warning is not a live-service or early access game, which means that we can't promise updates with more content. The game contains what it says on the Steam store, and any additional updates are a bonus.
The CW team is made up of 5 developers, all of whom have been working non-stop on several projects for the last couple of years.

We've explained a bit why there haven't been many updates here, but for those of you who missed it: the CW team took a break from a longer project called HASTE to make Content Warning. Once CW was more stable after its launch, they had promised to come back to HASTE to finish it together with that team, which they did. After that the CW team have all been working on different projects, and at the moment, there are no plans to return to CW. If this changes, we will let you all know!
If you’re having issues finding other players, we recommend checking out the CW Discord, where you can find others to play with!

We’re working with a porting studio to get the game onto other platforms, so we hope to have more news about that soon! They're also the ones who've worked to make this patch possible, as the original CW developers are busy with other projects.

In the last couple of patches, we, with your help, solved several issues that led to videos failing to extract. We want to thank everyone who sent in logs and other information to help us fix as many of these bugs as possible. In this latest patch, we also did some fixes that may help.

There are sadly a million things that can lead to extraction issues for the videos, some of which we have no control over on our end (like one teammate having a weird file structure on their computer), but we have done our best to fix the most common ones. If you are still having issues, please check out our troubleshooting page.
You can find help in our Content Warning FAQ for the most common issues. If you still need help, you can also reach out to support@landfall.se for troubleshooting or to ask questions about the game.
Hello everyone! Thanks to all of you who reported issues with videos failing to extract following the latest patch. We've released some more fixes for this bug.
More fixes for extraction failure when trying to get your video

releases.displayName: Small update! Mod support and fixes 👻

items.text: Added
Controller support (rebindable using SteamInput)
Steam Workshop support for mods
Fixes
A bunch of defibrillator fixes, for example not being able to speak after being rezzed
Fixes related to the extraction failing when you try to get your video
Expanded shadow settings allow for higher-quality shadows
Made tooltips correctly display rebindable keys
Made select items 1-3 rebindable
Matchmaking now prioritises lower ping matches
When we launched CW there were immediately a bunch of really cool mods being made, so we're super happy to make it possible for those mods to be on the Steam workshop!

The CW team is small and doesn’t have enough capacity for continuous updates alongside their other work, so having mod support is a great way to empower the community to create cool new stuff! We had hoped to have this up and running earlier but it took a little longer than expected.
If you are a modder, here is the current documentation for creating and uploading mods: https://github.com/landfallgames/ExampleCWPlugin
There’s also an unofficial modding Discord you can join to find out more about Content Warning mods.
We can’t wait to see what kind of mods you all create!

In the last couple of patches we, with your help, solved several issues that led to videos failing to extract. We want to thank everyone who sent in logs and other information to help us fix as many of these bugs as possible.

There are sadly a million things that can lead to extraction issues for the videos, some of which we have no control over on our end (like one team-mate having a weird file structure on their computer) but we have done our best to fix the most common ones. If you are still having issues after this update please reach out to our support at support@landfall.se so we can help troubleshoot.
As we spoke about in our last patch, the dev-team is made up of five developers who took some time off from their main project to work on Content Warning.

The other project has been in the works since 2021 together with a bigger team, so it’s important to the devs that they come back to finish it. As we explained in our latest post, they won’t work more on CW during this time. Therefore, we don’t know when or if there will be more Content Warning updates.

That said we’re very happy with what Content Warning has become! It’s been a wild ride for a six-week project that blew all of our expectations out of the water. We’re thankful to you all who have been on this journey down to the old world with us so far, and we can’t wait to see what mod support brings!
If you’re having issues finding other players, we recommend checking out our Discord where you can find others to play with https://discord.gg/contentwarning
We’re working with a porting studio to get the game onto other platforms, so we hope to have more news about that next year. Porting also means we will add achievements for PC!

You can find help in our Content Warning FAQ for the most common issues if you still need help you can also reach out to support@landfall.se for help troubleshooting or to ask questions about the game.

releases.displayName: Patch: Language match-making, a new item and fixes!

items.text: Hello everyone! Here’s a new patch adding language matchmaking for those of you who want to play in your native language, a new purchasable item, infinite loading fixes and more solutions to the video extraction problems.
🛠️ Added a new purchasable item, "Sketch Pad"
🛠️ Added new matchmaking options for spoken languages
🛠️ Additional LODs for slightly better GPU performance on older GPUs
🪲 Fixed issues with infinite loading
🪲 Fixed additional issues with video extraction failing (please send us logs when this happens)
🪲 Fixed issue with "hold the bomb" contract not being able to be fulfilled

This will be the last patch for a while since ThePetHen, Skog, Zorro, Wilnyl and Philip have prior commitments to another project that they have been working on with another team since 2021. In the meantime, we are looking into getting the game onto other platforms! We hope to have more news about that and the future of Content Warning before the end of the year.

We also want to shout out the amazing modders working on fun mods and improvements for the game. You can find more information about modding on the unofficial modding discord here: https://discord.gg/vEG7FZGsdk

releases.displayName: Content Warning Small Patch fixing various issues

items.text: 🪲 Fixed issue where recording player's voice would be too low
🪲Localization Fixes
🪲 Fixed some issues with video extraction failing - we are still looking into this
🛠️ Added more logging to help us figure out the video extraction issue
Please send us your logs if video extraction fails with the new update! This will help us figure out why it is happening so we can fix it!
The player log contains information on your latest game session which can help us track down bugs. Recreate the bug you’re experiencing in the game before getting the log here:
Press and hold the Windows key and the letter R on your keyboard
Type appdata into the prompt that appears
Then navigate to LocalLow\Landfall Games\Content Warning> locate the file called “Player” and send it to support@landfall.se

We know a lot of you are wondering about content updates, we're currently focusing on fixes and quality-of-life features. As we've spoken about in the past we don't do estimates for updates as it leads to crunch for the team but we will let you know when and if a new update is on the way! :)

🪲Fixed some sound issues including the sound echoing too much

We’re still looking into the other bugs reported with the Extraction bug being one of our priorities, with this update we’ve added logs to see if we can figure out what goes wrong. If the Extraction Failure bug happens to you please send us your logs (Found in: Appdata/Local Low/LandfallGames/Content Warning/player.log and player-prev.log while the game is still running) to support@landfall.se so that we can have a look, your logs may be the key to fixing it.
If you’re having issues please check out our FAQ landfall.se/content-warning-faq for some common fixes.
PS our friends over at HappyHead Games just released their new game Spanky! if you like physics multiplayer games you should check it out.
